visualCharacteristics.purpose: Small breadcrumb trail at the top of article and guide pages
visualCharacteristics.layout: single line of 10-12px navy text, underlined links, slash after every item

contentPattern.structure: last row, single cell: a list (or paragraphs) of links in order; an item without a link is the current page. Optional first row: accessible name of the navigation
contentPattern.sourceDescription: cmp-breadcrumb nav > ol (Home / Speak your heart out)

usage: Top of guide pages such as Obesity and your heart: a guide for meaningful discussions.
reuseGuidance: Author the trail by hand; nothing is derived from the URL.
